status: character requirements for Phase 7A pre-production (no artwork yet)
premise: A driver at a modern gas station watches the pump fail to stop and gasoline overflow (an exaggerated what-if), then a CLICK rewinds it: the nozzle itself knows when to stop. The camera dives into a cutaway of the nozzle to show the sensing hole, the airflow, the vacuum, the diaphragm and the latch.

setting.place: a clean, modern self-service gas station in daylight

ownerDecisions: the protagonist's gender and look (kept open)
whether this driver becomes Hold Up's recurring modern everyperson, shared with the 1873 saloon story's time-traveller (recommended: one character, not two)

requests.description: An ordinary, relatable modern adult filling up their own car: the viewer's stand-in. Expressive and a little comedic; on screen briefly in the hook, the rewind and the payoff.

outfit.description: everyday modern clothes that read instantly at phone size

requests.personality: relatable, slightly clumsy, curious; big readable reactions
requests.silhouette: simple and friendly: compact Hold Up proportions, a distinctive hairstyle or cap, one strong jacket colour that reads against concrete and a red or white pump
accessories: fuel nozzle (held; the dispensing nozzle prop, not character artwork)

role: panicked (wide eyes, raised brows, small open mouth) for the overflow
relieved (soft smile, lowered brows) after the click
curious (one brow up, small mouth) as the explanation starts
impressed (raised brows, open smile) at the payoff

poses: holding a nozzle in the filler neck (arm extended, hand at the nozzle grip)
recoiling from the overflow (lean back, free hand up)
relaxed stance, nozzle hung back on the pump
